programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Road Trip to Wood Werks Supply

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking on Dark Wood

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Dados with a Router Plane
programme.desc: One of my all-time favorite hand tools is the router plane. However, I very rarely use it to create joinery. In my shop, its sole purpose is fine-tuning. The blade can be set at a fixed distance from the base so it is incredibly effective at creating dados and grooves of a consistent depth.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lumber Rack aka Racking My Brain
programme.desc: The lumber rack is the unsung hero of the woodworking shop. Its responsible for holding our raw materials safely, securely, and in an organized fashion until we're ready to use them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Sharpen a Card Scraper
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to sharpen your card scraper.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Domino Step Stool aka One Small Step
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to easily make an elegant domino step stool.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 6
programme.desc: Now we’re really getting into the meat of the project. I show how to create a jig for the hinge mortises. I also cover the joinery being used to connect the legs to the case. I finish up by cutting the dados and rabbets in the case sides, and show you just how imperfect our machines can be. The router plane saves the day!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fancy Workbench Cabinet With String Inlay
programme.desc: A workbench cabinet that will last for generations!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 3
programme.desc: This episode is primarily focused on the design of the legs. I present several options and show how I create a basic template. At the end, you will see the final test leg. The process of cutting the leg itself will be covered in detail when we cut the final legs out of the bubinga stock.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Simple Frame and Panel
programme.desc: I'm currently working on an Executive Desk that features large panels on the sides and front. I pondered the various ways to construct the panels along with the rails and legs that would comprise the "frame" and ultimately decided on a very simple solution: face-gluing the rails to the panels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 11
programme.desc: I resaw the spalted maple panels on the bandsaw using Laguna’s Resaw King. What a bandsaw blade! I then glue up the doors and begin creating the ebony plugs for the case. I finish up by showing my process for fitting inset doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woodworking in America 2016 Interviews
programme.desc: I had a great time at Woodworking in America 2016 and I had the opportunity to interview a few notable woodworkers from around the web. You just might recognize some of these faces.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortise and Tenon Options aka Tenons Anyone?
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the most important and the strongest joints in woodworking - Mortise and Tenon joints.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Beginner’s Cutting Board From the Woodworker’s Point of View!
programme.desc: A beginner's cutting board course from the woodworker's point of view.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hidden Wireless Charging in a Desk Top
programme.desc: Wireless charging is cool. Wireless charging that is completely hidden is even cooler! When I built my Executive Desk, I knew I wanted to include wireless charging as a feature but I didn't want to look at a charging pad all the time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 4-In-A-Row Game
programme.desc: This 4-In-A-Row Game is fun for the whole family and can be made with basic materials and tools. If you're not familiar with this classic game, the goal is to achieve four discs in a row while blocking your competitor from doing the same. The fact that it's oversized makes it that much more fun.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Way to Set Up a Bandsaw!
programme.desc: I can say without a doubt that this is the best way to set up a bandsaw.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Duane’s Steamer Trunk Part 3
programme.desc: I go over some pre-finishing tips and finish the inside of the trunk. I then go through the entire assembly and glueup process from start to finish. I then discuss the trunk’s lid, which is different from the original plan.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Multi-Function Toy Chest
programme.desc: The Multi-Function Toy Chest is the 2014 Woodworkers Fighting Cancer charity build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Tour and Sub-Panel
programme.desc: Before we get too far with the renovation details, I'd like to take a minute or two to show you the garage space itself. I'm working with about 950 square feet which is pretty respectable!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: French Cleat Storage System
programme.desc: A French cleat is as ingenious as it is simple. It involves securing a strip of wood with a 45 degree bevel to the wall, and then securing an opposing beveled strip on the back of a cabinet or anything you want to hang. Its incredibly strong and versatile. Its a great way to hang cabinetry and as you’ll see in this video, it can be used to make an awesome modular wall storage unit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Joinery and Assembly
programme.desc: A beautiful rustic table made from Western Red Cedar featuring Domino XL joinery.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Tops - Ends - Finish
programme.desc: The table top and bench tops come together along with the breadboard ends. Watco Teak Oil is used for the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Setup & Tune a Tablesaw Part 1
programme.desc: Our tools are no good to us if they aren’t tuned up properly. As the “heart” of the workshop, its crucial that our table saws are configured to perform their best. So whether you are setting up a new saw, or tuning up your current one, this video guide will get you where you need to be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Bought a Sawstop! - First Impressions
programme.desc: I bought a SawStop. Hopefully I won't regret it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Basic Tool Set for the Beginning Woodworker
programme.desc: There are lots of different opinions out there as to what you actually need to do woodworking. Truth is, you don't need much. Think about our ancestors and what they were able to accomplish using only the most rudimentary tools. But in the 21st century, we aren't building for our survival and most of us have family and day jobs that come before woodworking, so we use modern tools to help us build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Did My Cutting Board Split?
programme.desc: I don't know if this ever happens to you, but sometimes my tools just get out of whack and start to sound funny. Take a listen and let me know if you have any advice. Also have you ever wondered why end grain cutting boards are prone to splitting? Here's a couple of reasons why!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: DeWalt Tracksaw Review
programme.desc: Here is my review of the DeWalt Tracksaw. As much as I tried to focus solely on the Track saw, it's nearly impossible not to draw comparisons to the Festool TS line of plunge saws. Let me sum it all up by saying you need to be really picky to find distinctions that will make a real difference to the average woodworker.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Make a Vacuum Bag aka A Pressing Matter
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to make your own vacuum bag for veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: MicroJig MJ Splitter SteelPRO
programme.desc: In the past, we have discussed the use of Featherboards & Pushsticks as well as the benefits of using something like MicroJig's GRR-Ripper. But the one safety device we have yet to focus on, which could be considered the most important, is the tablesaw splitter/riving knife.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wiping Varnish Shootout
programme.desc: As much as for my own curiosity as everyone else's edification, I wanted to do a side by side comparison between some popular variations of wiping varnish. I've used all of these finishes in the past but I have never used them side by side. By finishing some test boards, I figured I could not only gather information about their application characteristics but also the resulting look of the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 7
